data.body_html:
Imagine gliding across the Mediterranean as the sun dips behind La Concha mountain, a glass of chilled champagne in hand, and the scent of salt and tapas in the air. Our Marbella sunset cruise with champagne & tapas 2027 is designed for couples, small groups, and anyone seeking a romantic evening on the Costa del Sol. Departing from Puerto Banús, you'll sail past the Golden Mile, Cabopino, and Cala del Faro, with the skipper handling everything. Prices start at €749 for two hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including drinks, snacks, and a licensed skipper. For a longer escape, upgrade to four hours (€1,499) or opt for the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4h) with a free jet ski. This is not a generic tour—it's your private yacht, your sunset, your evening.

Why Choose a Private Sunset Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline offers some of the best sunset views in Europe. From Puerto Banús, you can watch the sky turn pink and orange over the Sierra Blanca mountains. A private cruise means no crowds, no set itineraries—just you, your guests, and the sea. Unlike packed catamaran tours, our yachts are exclusive to your party. The skipper can adjust the route based on your preferences: anchor near a quiet cove for a swim, cruise past the luxury villas of the Golden Mile, or stop at Cala del Faro for a photo. With champagne and tapas included, you don't need to worry about a thing. It's the kind of evening that turns a holiday into a memory.

Our Yachts for the Sunset Cruise

We offer a range of yachts departing from Puerto Banús. For a classic sunset charter, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal—both priced at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. If you want more space, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) are available on request. All yachts come with a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and the champagne & tapas package. See our full fleet on the [Marbella boat rental](/experiences/) page.

What's Included in the Champagne & Tapas Package?

Every sunset charter includes a welcome glass of champagne or cava, plus a selection of tapas: local olives, marcona almonds, manchego cheese, Iberian ham, and sun-dried tomatoes. Throughout the cruise, you can enjoy white wine, beer, soft drinks, and sparkling water. The snacks are light—think grazing, not a full meal. If you have dietary restrictions, let us know 48 hours in advance. We can also arrange a custom menu (e.g., sushi, seafood platter) at an extra cost. The skipper will keep your glasses topped up as you watch the sunset. No hidden extras: the price includes all drinks, snacks, skipper, fuel, and 21% IVA.

Best Sunset Spots Along the Marbella Coast

Our skippers know the prime locations for sunset views. Here are the top spots you might visit:

  • Cala del Faro – A secluded cove near the lighthouse, perfect for photos.
  • Cabopino – Quiet anchorage with views of the dunes and the setting sun.
  • Puerto Banús entrance – Watch the yachts sail in as the sky turns gold.
  • La Concha mountain backdrop – The sun drops behind the iconic peak.
  • Estepona coast – A longer cruise (4h+) for a panoramic horizon.

Your skipper will choose the best route based on wind and sea conditions. Typically, you'll head west from Puerto Banús towards Cala del Faro, then return as the lights of Marbella Marina twinkle on.

How to Book Your Sunset Cruise for 2027

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp or email with your preferred date and group size. We recommend reserving at least two weeks in advance for summer weekends. A 50% deposit secures the booking, with the balance due seven days before departure. We accept bank transfer, credit card, or PayPal. For last-minute availability, call us—we sometimes have open slots. All departures are from Puerto Banús, with easy parking nearby. If you're staying on the Golden Mile or in Marbella centre, we can arrange a taxi transfer. For more details, check our [Marbella sunset cruise](/experiences/marbella-sunset-cruise-champagne-tapas-2027/) page.

Frequently asked questions

What time does the sunset cruise depart?

In summer (May–September), we depart at 18:00 to catch the golden hour. In winter (October–April), departures are at 16:00. The exact timing is adjusted weekly based on sunset times, and we confirm with you 48 hours before.

What is included in the champagne and tapas package?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and 21% IVA. The drinks package features champagne, cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. We also serve light tapas-style snacks (olives, almonds, local cheeses, and cured meats). You can request a custom menu at an extra cost.

Can we bring our own food or drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food or drinks. However, the included champagne and tapas are designed to complement the sunset experience. If you bring additional alcohol, please note that glass bottles are discouraged for safety; we provide plastic cups.

How many people can join the sunset cruise?

Capacity depends on the yacht. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 take up to 9 and 11 guests respectively. The Mangusta 80 (24m) can host 12 guests. For larger groups, consider the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús.

What is the cancellation policy?

We offer free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure. Within 72 hours, a 50% charge applies. In case of bad weather (strong winds or storms), we reschedule or fully refund. We do not cancel for light rain or overcast skies.

Is the sunset cruise suitable for a proposal?

Absolutely. Many guests choose this cruise for proposals. We can arrange a private photographer (extra cost) or a special bottle of vintage Champagne. Let us know in advance, and we will coordinate with the skipper to anchor at a scenic spot like Cala del Faro.

Can we swim during the sunset cruise?

Yes, if weather and sea conditions allow. The skipper will anchor near a calm cove (e.g., Cala Cortés or Cabopino) for a short swim. We provide towels and a freshwater rinse. Swimming is not guaranteed if the sea is rough.

Contact us via WhatsApp or email. We require a 50% deposit to secure the date. The balance is due 7 days before departure. We accept bank transfer, credit card, or PayPal. Book at least 2 weeks in advance for summer weekends.
